newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy and wheat mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy and wheat mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn, soybean and wheat basis values were mostly steady Tuesday, with U.S. export sources reporting a lack of buyer interest in all markets.
U.S. exporters said results of Iraq's tender for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat may be Wednesday or later this week. It seeks the wheat for April and May shipment.
